title: US NABCEP Solar Directory Scraper Input

includeAccreditedCompanies.title: Include NABCEP Accredited Companies (CEO/Owner Leads)
includeAccreditedCompanies.description: Extract NABCEP Accredited Solar Installation Companies from nabcep.org/accredited/ (includes Company Name, CEO/Owner Name & Title, Street Address, City, State, Zip, and Website).

certType.title: Certification Tier Filter
certType.description: Filter the 6,751 directory listings by NABCEP tier: All, Board Certified Professionals (2,673), or Associates (4,078).

country.title: Country Filter (Optional)
country.description: Filter by country slug (e.g., 'usa', 'canada', 'puerto-rico'). Leave empty for all countries.

state.title: US State / Province Filter (Optional)
state.description: Filter by state/province name or 2-letter code (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'FL', 'IL'). Leave empty for all states.

searchQuery.title: Keyword / Company / Name Search (Optional)
searchQuery.description: Search by installer name, company name, or certification number.

onlyWithCompanyOrWebsite.title: Only Keep Records With Company Name or Website
onlyWithCompanyOrWebsite.description: When enabled, skips individual installers who did not list an employer/company name or website URL.

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to extract (0 = unlimited, extracts all matching records).

concurrency.title: Concurrent Page Requests
concurrency.description: Number of directory pages to fetch in parallel via HTTP.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Works without proxies for light runs; enable Apify Proxy for full 6,750+ record extractions.
